decisions.reason: As an express program close to the core offer and still shown in 2024, it likely benefits from process investments and public commitment, though its more incremental character makes it somewhat easier to fold back into the standard range than the more prominent launches.

The seventy-two-hour express program is a visible service promise tied to the firm's reliability positioning, so sunk organizational effort and reputational commitment make management likely to continue it despite possible operational strain.

A standalone express-delivery line with several models signals substantial public commitment and investment in a strategic capability close to the established business, which escalation of commitment makes management reluctant to abandon.

The online ordering and digital services platform fits the firm's stated move toward deeper advisory and service support and has its own page, so it is both strategically central and visibly committed, lowering the chance of withdrawal.

The fire and smoke protection door moved from a simple mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024, indicating rising commitment in a compliance- and safety-critical core category that management is especially likely to persist with.
